description: Bound tree definition. Field kinds: node (child), node? (optional child), nodes (child list), value (symbol, constant or flag; not a child). Expressions additionally carry type, legacyType, constantValue; every node carries syntax and hasErrors. Regenerate bound/nodes.js, visitor.js and rewriter.js with packages/compiler/scripts/generate-bound-nodes.js.

expressions.name: BadExpression
expressions.doc: An expression that could not be bound; children are kept for error recovery.

expressions.name: Literal
expressions.doc: A literal or folded constant (also nameof).

expressions.name: DefaultExpression
expressions.doc: default(T).

expressions.name: Local
expressions.doc: A reference to a local variable.

expressions.name: Parameter
expressions.doc: A reference to a parameter.

expressions.name: ThisReference
expressions.doc: this (explicit or implied receiver).

expressions.name: TypeExpression
expressions.doc: A type used as the receiver of a static member access.

expressions.name: FieldAccess
expressions.doc: Instance (receiver) or static (no receiver) field read, including enum constants.

expressions.name: PropertyAccess
expressions.doc: Property read or write target; source, framework or builtin property.

expressions.name: IndexerAccess
expressions.doc: Indexer read or write target on a framework type.

expressions.name: ArrayAccess
expressions.doc: Array element read or write target.

expressions.name: ArrayLength
expressions.doc: Length of an array or string.

expressions.name: Call
expressions.doc: Method invocation. `method` is a source, framework or builtin MethodSymbol; `intrinsic` optionally overrides the builtin ABI entry.

expressions.name: ObjectCreationExpression
expressions.doc: new T(args) { initializers }.

expressions.name: ObjectInitializerMember
expressions.doc: Member = value inside an object initializer.

expressions.name: CollectionElementInitializer
expressions.doc: One element of a collection initializer: a call to Add.

expressions.name: ArrayCreation
expressions.doc: new T[length] or new T[] { ... }.

expressions.name: DelegateCreationExpression
expressions.doc: Method group converted to a delegate.

expressions.name: UnaryOperator
expressions.doc: Unary + - ! ~.

expressions.name: IncrementOperator
expressions.doc: ++ and --, prefix or postfix.

expressions.name: BinaryOperator
expressions.doc: Arithmetic, comparison, bitwise and short-circuit operators. `method` is set for framework operator methods; `negate` for != through an equality method.

expressions.name: NullCoalescingOperator
expressions.doc: left ?? right.

expressions.name: ConditionalOperator
expressions.doc: condition ? consequence : alternative.

expressions.name: AssignmentOperator
expressions.doc: left = right.

expressions.name: CompoundAssignmentOperator
expressions.doc: left op= right.

expressions.name: NullCoalescingAssignmentOperator
expressions.doc: left ??= right.

expressions.name: EventAssignmentOperator
expressions.doc: receiver.Event += handler or -= handler.

expressions.name: Conversion
expressions.doc: A conversion; `conversion` is a Conversion classification.

expressions.name: InterpolatedString
expressions.doc: $"..."; parts are Literal (text) or StringInsert.

expressions.name: StringInsert
expressions.doc: {value,alignment:format}.

expressions.name: AwaitExpression
expressions.doc: await expression; `awaiter` is the runtime await method.

expressions.name: SwitchExpression
expressions.doc: value switch { arms }.

expressions.name: SwitchExpressionArm
expressions.doc: pattern => value; a null pattern is the discard arm.

expressions.name: ConstantPattern
expressions.doc: A constant case label or pattern.

expressions.name: CollectionExpression
expressions.doc: [a, ..b] targeting an array, List<T> or HashSet<T>. `creation` builds the backing collection held in `collection`; `conversion` (optional) converts it to the target (ToArray).

expressions.name: CollectionElement
expressions.doc: One element added through `addMethod`.

expressions.name: CollectionSpread
expressions.doc: ..expression: a bound foreach statement that adds every item held in `iterationVariable`.

expressions.name: Sequence
expressions.doc: Lowered form: side effects evaluated in order, then the value. `locals` are temporaries scoped to the sequence.

statements.name: BadStatement
statements.doc: A statement that could not be bound.

statements.name: Block
statements.doc: { ... } with the locals declared directly in it.

statements.name: MultipleLocalDeclarations
statements.doc: A local declaration statement: one sequence point, several declarators.

statements.name: ForStatement
statements.doc: for (initializer; condition; increment) body. `locals` are the loop-scoped locals.

statements.name: ForEachStatement
statements.doc: foreach over an array (`expression`) or over the GetEnumerator pattern (`enumerator`). `locals` holds the iteration variable.

statements.name: ForEachEnumerator
statements.doc: The pattern-based parts of a foreach: the enumerator declaration, MoveNext(), the iteration variable declaration from Current, and Dispose().

statements.name: UsingStatement
statements.doc: using (resources) body. Each resource holds its declaration and the bound null test and Dispose call.

statements.name: UsingResource
statements.doc: One using resource: declaration, `resource != null` and `resource.Dispose()`.

statements.name: BreakStatement
statements.doc: break; or the C# 15 labeled form.

statements.name: ContinueStatement
statements.doc: continue; or the C# 15 labeled form.

statements.name: ConditionalAccessAssignment
statements.doc: receiver?.member = value; `receiverLocal` holds the receiver for the assignment.
